verdicts.reason: A puts the CTA first at the top, shrinks the can to an unrecognisable icon, and sets the SOLSTICE wordmark below the headline at almost headline weight, so the reading order is backwards and the hero product is lost. B also opens with the CTA, jammed against the top-left, and packs the headline, logo and subcopy into a cramped top band; the subcopy runs nearly edge to edge and the bottom is half empty. Still, B keeps the can at a recognisable size and in proportion, so it is less broken.
